Subject: Re: how arrange that outgoing email is sent on the correct outgoing ip

Mark D. Anderson wrote:
>>> Everything is cool when a CGI for domain1.org sends email with a "From"
>>> of "pvosgpr@domain1.org".
>>> Everything is mostly cool also for domain2.org, but sometimes email is
>>> rejected by the destination with messages like this:
>>>    554 #5.5.4 Relaying denied. IP name lookup failed for IP1
>>> (Where "IP1" is the actual ip address.)
>>>
>>> That is, the destination doesn't like the fact that it is seeing email
>>> with a "From" of domain2.org being sent from the ip address of domain1.org
>>>       
>> Do you have any evidence that this is what the recipient
>> domain requires?  (This would be a very stupid rule.) Can
>> you post some log lines showing the guilty party and exact
>> reject message?
>>
>> The actual cause is very likely something else, you may need
>> to contact the postmaster at the recipient domain to find
>> their requirements.
>>     
>
> Here you go, nothing changed except the local part of the destination.
> The domain solidarityforafrica.org is 64.85.161.177 while postfix is
> binding a different ip on the same host (64.85.161.176).
> And I assume that is what rr.com is not liking:
>
> Feb 14 13:48:48 b02s01mr postfix/qmgr[27946]: F1757930065: from=, size=515, nrcpt=1 (queue active)
> Feb 14 13:48:49 b02s01mr postfix/smtp[13874]: F1757930065: host hrndva-smtpin01.mail.rr.com[71.74.56.243] refused to talk to me: 554-hrndva-mxlb.mail.rr.com 554 #5.5.4 Relaying denied. IP name lookup failed for 64.85.161.176
>   

64.85.161.176 does not resolve. unless you have other infos, this has nothing to do with the domains you server. 

add a PTR to map the IP to a name, say:
64.85.161.176	-> host2.solidarityforafrica.org
and add an A record to map this name to the IP:
host2solidarityforafrica.org -> 64.85.161.176



> Feb 14 13:48:49 b02s01mr postfix/smtp[13874]: F1757930065: to=, relay=hrndva-smtpin02.mail.rr.com[71.74.56.244]:25, delay=54985, delays=54983/0.01/1.4/0, dsn=4.0.0, status=deferred (host hrndva-smtpin02.mail.rr.com[71.74.56.244] refused to talk to me: 554-hrndva-mxlb.mail.rr.com 554 #5.5.4 Relaying denied. IP name lookup failed for 64.85.161.176)
>
